reviewer: Codex model visual inspection; no independent human study

chair.observation: All 16 panels inspected. Stock chair is recognizable. First-eight coverage has broad mottling across cushion and frame; truncated RGB is washed out. The tail remains spatially extensive at k16. Near-uniform front/median/mean depth appearance does not repair incomplete contributor mass.

drums.observation: All 16 panels inspected. Stock drum kit is recognizable, while first-eight alpha is low over drum/cymbal interiors and retains scattered rims. Truncated RGB is extremely pale. Missing tail dominates broad object interiors; this is not a usable calibrated complete layer distribution.

ficus.observation: All 16 panels inspected separately. Leaves, branches and pot are clearly visible in stock RGB. First-eight alpha is weak on foliage and pot alike; truncated RGB is almost white. Variance highlights some overlapping leaves but cannot establish a line advantage. k16 still omits more than half the foreground mass.

lego.observation: All 16 panels inspected. Stock RGB and native alpha show a solid recognizable excavator. First-eight alpha is strongly mottled across platform, wheels and body; truncated RGB is pale and splat-patterned. Depth panels retain silhouette but do not establish reliable retained layer mass. Large tail remains at k16.
